app.title: Performance Hub
onboarding.title: Build your athlete dashboard
onboarding.note: Your data stays in this browser unless you choose cloud sync.
onboarding.import_note: Import your OpenPowerlifting history in one tap.
profile.name: Name
planner.title: Meet Planner
planner.note: A simple starting plan is suggested from your current best lifts. Adjust every attempt as you like.
meetday.title: Tap Good or Miss after each attempt
progress.title: Competition history
progress.note: Import directly from OpenPowerlifting. CSV is kept only as an advanced fallback.
tools.title: Strength context, weight class and goals
tools.note: Reference context is based on recent Raw full-power OpenPowerlifting performances. It is descriptive, not a prediction.
report.empty: Complete the meet to build your report
account.title: Keep your Hub on every device
account.intro: Sign in to keep your athlete profile, goals and meet plan across devices. Your data on this device stays available without an account.
auth.subtitle: Choose how you want to continue.
auth.code_title: Sign in with an email code
auth.code_note: Existing cloud account? We'll email a six-digit code. No password needed.
auth.network_error: Cannot reach the account service. Check your connection and try again. If it persists, the cloud API may be blocking this app.
auth.timeout: The account service did not respond. Please try again later.
auth.server_error: The account service returned an unexpected response. Please try again later.
account.note: No password. We email you a 6-digit sign-in code. Your athlete profile, goals, meet plan and history can then be synced to powerlifting-calculator.com.
settings.title: App settings
settings.language_note: Choose the app language. “System language” follows your phone or browser.
dynamic.add_meet_date: Add a meet date to start the countdown.
dynamic.no_goal: No saved goal yet. Use Goal Planner to create one.
dynamic.no_competitions: No upcoming crawler events are available right now. You can still enter a meet date manually.
dynamic.plan_saved: Attempt plan saved on this device.
dynamic.confirm_clear: Remove all imported competition history from this device?
dynamic.search_prompt: Enter a lifter name, username, or paste an OpenPowerlifting profile URL.
dynamic.matches: {{count}} matching OpenPowerlifting profiles found. Choose yours:
dynamic.no_match: No matching profile found. Try the exact OpenPowerlifting profile URL.
dynamic.results_stored: {{count}} competition result(s) stored on this device.
dynamic.chart_need_two: Import at least two meets to show progress.
dynamic.reference_unavailable: Reference data is loading or not available yet.
dynamic.add_bw_total: Add bodyweight and a current total to calculate strength context.
dynamic.no_reference: No suitable reference class is available.
dynamic.valid_sim: Enter a valid bodyweight and projected total.
dynamic.valid_goal: Enter a valid target DOTS and bodyweight.
dynamic.above_current: {{gap}} kg above your current best total.
dynamic.below_current: {{gap}} kg below your current best total.
dynamic.goal_saved_text: {{dots}} DOTS at {{bw}} kg requires about {{total}} kg total.
dynamic.saved_history: Meet result saved to your Progress history.
dynamic.need_success: Record at least one successful lift before saving the meet.
dynamic.card_saved: Result card saved as a PNG image.
dynamic.code_sent: Code sent. Check your email; it expires in 10 minutes.
dynamic.cloud_found: Cloud data found. Choose Load cloud data to replace this device, or Upload this device to keep your local version.
dynamic.cloud_linked: Cloud account linked. Use Upload this device or Load cloud data when you want to sync.
dynamic.cloud_loaded: Cloud data loaded onto this device.
dynamic.no_cloud: No cloud profile has been saved yet.
finder.title: Find your next competition
finder.note: Search nearby first, but keep worldwide events available.
finder.location_needed: Set a home location or use your current location to find nearby meets.
finder.location_unsupported: Location sharing is not supported on this device.
finder.location_ready: Current location is ready for nearby search.
settings.home_location_note: Used only to sort and filter nearby competitions. Enter a city manually or share your current location.
dynamic.percentile_explain: Your DOTS score uses the sum of your saved best squat, bench and deadlift and your profile bodyweight. The {{pct}}th percentile means this score is estimated to exceed about {{pct}}% of recorded performances in the reference group.
dynamic.context_explain: About {{above}}% of reference performances are above this score. The context label ({{label}}) is a rounded band, while the bar marks percentile {{pct}} on a 0–100 scale.
dynamic.reference_explain: The reference uses your latest meet's weight class when available; otherwise it uses the class nearest your profile bodyweight. n counts performances, not individual lifters.
settings.profile_note: Enter your birth date or age for the legacy age-adjusted total, as on the website.
settings.age_input_note: Type your date as DD.MM.YYYY (for example 30.09.1986), or enter your age. Editing the age afterwards clears the date.
settings.invalid_birth_format: Enter a real date in DD.MM.YYYY format, for example 30.09.1986.
settings.age_from_date: Age calculated from the entered date. Edit the age to use a manual value instead.
settings.age_manual: Manual age selected. The date of birth was cleared.
settings.invalid_birth_date: Choose a date of birth that gives an age between 13 and 100.
auth.email_signup_note: Enter your email. A six-digit code verifies it and creates your account. Your cloud data is stored on powerlifting-calculator.com. No password needed.
auth.email_signin_note: Enter your email to receive a six-digit sign-in code. If you are new, verifying your email also creates your free account.
auth.connection_ready: The account service is reachable. You can request a code; this check did not send an email.
auth.backend_missing: The account backend needs an update. Please try again later.
auth.api_rate_limited: Please wait before requesting another code.
auth.api_mail_failed: The email could not be sent. Please try again later.
auth.api_expired_code: This code has expired. Request a new one.
auth.api_incorrect_code: That code is not correct. Check the six digits in your email.
auth.api_too_many_attempts: Too many incorrect attempts. Request a new code.
auth.api_session_error: Your session could not be saved. Please try again later.
auth.create_profile_note: Your account is ready. Create your athlete dashboard to save your data.
auth.google_note: Use your Google account. No password or email code needed.
manual.note: Use this when a competition is missing from OpenPowerlifting.
manual.title: Add competition result
manual.name: Meet name
manual.attempt_note: Optional attempt details. Leave blank if you only know the best lifts.
manual.invalid: Enter a date, meet name, bodyweight and at least one lift.
manual.updated: Existing meet updated instead of creating a duplicate.
help.title: How to use Performance Hub
help.intro: A quick guide to the main parts of the Hub.
help.dashboard_text: See your current total, DOTS, next meet and goal.
help.progress_text: Import OpenPowerlifting history or add a missing meet manually, then follow your progress.
help.planner_text: Find competitions and build your attempt plan.
help.meetday_text: Record Good or Miss attempts during the competition and build your report.
help.tools_text: Use strength context, weight-class simulation and goal planning.
help.account_text: Sign in to sync your profile, goals, plan and meet history across devices.
help.tip: If a meet is missing from OpenPowerlifting, add it manually in Progress.
help.account_card_text: See a quick guide to Dashboard, Progress, Meet Planner, Meet Day and Tools.
finder.feed_failed: The competition feed could not be loaded.
finder.feed_no_filter_match: The feed is working, but no loaded competitions match these filters.
finder.feed_no_events: The feed returned no competitions. Check the crawler / Hub sync.
dynamic.no_valid_results: No valid competition results were returned.
auth.google_load_failed: Google sign-in could not be loaded.
dynamic.csv_no_valid_meets: No valid powerlifting meet rows were found.
profile.edit_note: Update your athlete details. Nothing changes until you save.
reset.title: Reset app
reset.note: Clear this device and start again from the first screen. Your cloud account is not deleted.
reset.confirm: Reset this app on this device? Your local profile, meet plan, results, history, goals, location and sign-in session will be cleared. Your cloud account will not be deleted.
profile.validation: Please check the highlighted field. Use positive bodyweight, non-negative lifts and a whole-number age from 13 to 100.
backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.note: Save your profile, history, goals and meet plan to a file. Sign-in details are excluded. Keep the file private.
backup.replace_note: Restoring replaces this device’s data. An undo copy is kept here. Cloud data stays unchanged.
backup.restored: Backup restored. Cloud data was not changed.
data.invalid: This is not a valid Hub backup or cloud profile. Nothing was replaced.
data.too_large: The file exceeds the 5 MB limit.
sync.changed: Data or account changed during review. Start again to compare the latest versions.
sync.same: This device and cloud already match.
sync.review_note: Check both versions before confirming. Loading cloud data keeps an undo copy here.
sync.upload_prompt: Your device data is ready. Choose Upload this device to review and save it to cloud.
score.legacy_note: Reshel and age factors use the same legacy tables as the website. They are not verified official event results.
score.dots_boundary: DOTS uses the nearest bodyweight boundary: {{weight}} kg.
ux.note_find: Find an event or add a meet date in your profile.
ux.note_plan: Set a positive weight for every attempt before meet day.
ux.note_meet: Open competition mode when you are ready. Results stay on this device.
ux.note_report: All nine attempts are recorded. Save the report to your history.
ux.unsynced: Device changes have not been synced
ux.save_failed: Could not save. Free device storage and export a backup before closing.
ux.complete_note: Review the report and save it to your history.
ux.need_weight: Set a positive attempt weight first.
ux.valid_number: Enter a valid non-negative number within the allowed range. Comma or dot is accepted.
ux.native_email: On Android, sign in with your email code. Google sign-in needs separate native setup.
ux.session_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again; device data is preserved.
ux.score_total_note: Sum of your best squat, bench and deadlift in kilograms. Personal bests may come from different meets.
ux.score_dots_note: DOTS compares totals using sex and bodyweight. It does not adjust for age. This app uses the same formula and bodyweight limits as the website.
ux.score_reshel_note: Uses the website's legacy sex/bodyweight coefficient tables. Outside the stored range no score is shown. Table provenance is unverified; this is not an official competition result.
ux.score_age_note: Your total in kilograms multiplied by the website's legacy age factor for ages 14–90. Ages 24–39 use ×1. This is an adjusted total, not a DOTS or Reshel score.
